resources.string: Watch preview: pinch in to fit the entire frame inside the round screen with black margins; spread two fingers to enlarge it. Drag the image to move the visible area. Double-tap the preview outside the buttons to restore the default centered, full-screen view. These gestures only change the watch display. Use the bezel or camera settings to change the phone camera zoom. A single tap focuses at that point after a brief delay to distinguish it from a double tap. Changing the camera orientation or frame aspect ratio resets the view.
